## Player impact

What changes for the player?

## Behavioral-design check

- [ ] I completed the feature review card in `docs/BEHAVIORAL_DESIGN.md` or linked the relevant room card.
- [ ] The change preserves autonomy, competence, relatedness, fair recovery, and a natural stopping point.
- [ ] The change adds no opaque random reward, streak, scarcity, notification, autoplay, or pressure loop.
- [ ] Critical information remains available with reduced motion.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `node --check game.js`
- [ ] Keyboard and touch checked
- [ ] Responsive and reduced-motion behavior checked where relevant

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for player-visible changes.
- [ ] Updated `docs/DECISIONS.md` for durable product decisions.
- [ ] Added or updated a room card for level or portal work.

## Notes for reviewers

Include screenshots, a short recording, playtest evidence, risks, or follow-up work when relevant.
